name: Win-back
purpose: Invites lapsed customers back before they forget.
trigger: a customer enters the lapsed group: ordered before, nothing in 180 days, still subscribed

steps.name: Come back
steps.subject: It's been a while: here's 10% to come back

steps.name: Last call
steps.job: Says the code expires in 48 hours.
steps.subject: Last call: your 10% ends in 48 hours

rules: The group refills itself. Nobody is added by hand.
why: Nobody who came back gets chased again.
watch: Set the 180 days from the real gap between orders. Too early annoys regulars. Too late and they are gone.
